name: state_comPortActive
contract_behavior: D1 first-valid-wins latch: number of the COM device actively feeding (1..16); 0=none; latch acquired by the FIRST device delivering parseable telemetry (non-empty DataStream line while State∈{Streaming,Recording}); lines from other devices discarded; re-arbitrate ONLY on stream loss (latched port state ∉ {Streaming,Recording} ∨ silence >5 s)

name: state_caseState
contract_behavior: RealtimeState passthrough (tap-exposed ONLY — NO invented states): 0=Unknown/¬active-case,1=NotStarted,2=InProgress,3=Completed,4=Suspended,5=SimulationRunning

name: state_caseLanState
contract_behavior: LANManager.LANStatus passthrough (ComPortStates enum, tap-exposed ONLY): 0=None,1=Selected,2=Streaming,4=Recording,8=LostConnection,16=Pausing; unknown/unavailable=0

name: state_heartbeat
contract_behavior: +1/s ALWAYS while AddIn loaded (pipeline-alive: iCem up ∧ POC reading ∧ Modbus publishing); DECOUPLED from Streaming; D2 wrap 32000→0; frozen ⇔ iCem/AddIn dead

name: com_stream_zone
contract_behavior: 98 float slots; addr=4+idx*2; state block = regs 0..3 ONLY; 34 registry flecs entries idx 0..33 → regs 4..70; strict-numeric first-convertible-wins per address; badtype never claims; stale-hold on channel loss; EXCEPTION: idx0 regs 4..5 = int32 raw bits (com_idx0_timestamp row), idx1 stays float (com_idx1_unitnum row)

name: lan_stream_crio_zone
contract_behavior: 100 float slots; addr=200+idx*2; 96 cRIO signals = registry lan family idx 0..95 (ACE superframe sv 0x13120203/06/00/09/0C/0F per PROTOCOL.md); LAN-equipment sources ONLY (EquipmentVariableSource.SourceComPort==17); FULL 4-byte CDAB — byte-width casts BANNED; D4: lan_stream_crio owns the LAN liveness block (tick@0x13(19), flag@0x1B(27), counter@0x29(41)) — AddIn marks it per float-pair write (single mutex hold, like com)

name: raw_com_line_zone
contract_behavior: last received COM line from the LATCHED device (D1) split into CSV fields POSITIONAL over the raw line AS-IS — field i (0-based, ALL fields incl. excludeFromTelemetry 'Time & Date'/'Unit Num'; zone purpose = 'what lands in the string as numbers', template-agnostic flecs/plc/unipro/compupac) → parse double (NumberStyles.Float invariant) → float32 CDAB pair at 400+i*2; ≤100 fields (truncate at field 99); unparseable field ⇒ pair NOT written (stale-hold retains last good); shorter line ⇒ tail pairs stale-held (never zeroed); empty line = no-op; liveness = line-ARRIVAL evidence (fires even when 0 fields parse)

name: com_idx0_timestamp
contract_behavior: flecs 'Time & Date' arrives numeric as .NET UTC ticks; bus carries UnixTimestampSeconds int32 as RAW BITS — low word @ reg4, high word @ reg5, BE bytes per word (same wire image as a CDAB float pair) ⇒ int32/uint32 read in the consumer's standard word order yields unix seconds; float32 read = garbage BY DECREE (Modbus consumer owns read formatting); dispatch: com-write loop address==ComTimestampReg(4) ⇒ WriteInt32Pair, else WriteFloatPair

name: com_idx1_unitnum
contract_behavior: ASYMMETRY (Э2b T03): Unit Num STAYS float32 CDAB — small integer, float32-exact (<2^24); consumer reads the whole com zone as float; int-semantics exception exists ONLY at idx0

name: ace_full_reserve_zone
contract_behavior: DEFERRED: ace_full exhaustive ACE dump NOT DESIGNED — reserve only, NO writers (neither AddIn nor POC); AddIn write into 600+ = breach (writer guard AddInMaxReg=599)

name: header_liveness_com
contract_behavior: com_stream liveness: lastWriteTick u64@10, activeFlag u8@18, writeCount u32@37 — updated per float-pair write (single mutex hold)

name: header_liveness_raw
contract_behavior: raw_com_line liveness: lastWriteTick u64@28, activeFlag u8@36, writeCount u32@45 — updated once per line write

name: header_liveness_lan
contract_behavior: D4: the Lan liveness block governs lan_stream_crio (200..399) — 1.6.1 DUAL: AddIn per float-pair write ∧ POC LanBusSink V6 per frame batch (owner directive 2026-08-25); serialized by the shared mutex

name: ownership_law
contract_behavior: single-writer-per-register (lan_stream_crio = 1.6.1 DUAL: AddIn cRIO stream ∧ POC LanBusSink V6 decoded signals): AddIn surface = header regs 0..3 + com_stream 4..199 + lan_stream_crio 200..399 + raw_com_line 400..599; ace_full reserve 600..10000 = NOBODY (DEFERRED); POC's ONLY writer = LanBusSink V6 (lan cRIO window)

name: stale_hold_law
contract_behavior: ∀ channel loss/stop: NO writer zeroes body registers — last values persist; heartbeat (reg3) unaffected by channel state; zone activeFlag flips are header-only; raw zone: per-FIELD stale-hold (unparseable field ⇒ pair not written; shorter line ⇒ tail pairs retained)

name: dictionary_shape
contract_behavior: NEW bus files created with regCount=10001 (20066 B); FINAL shapes = layoutVer 5, regCount ∈ [650..65535], len==64+2N; legacy layouts (layoutVer 2..4) = upgrade sources ONLY: v2 650/1364, v3-small 1650/3364, v3-full/v4-full 8404/16872 ⇒ EXPAND once to 10001/20066 (body preserved byte-exact, tail zeroed, layoutVer=5)

name: ordered_restart_law
contract_behavior: expansion runs ONCE under Global\iCemDataMonitorBusMutex_v1 while the AddIn is the FIRST/ONLY opener; the named section capacity is frozen until ALL handles close — a live smaller-capacity section blocks the sized view (Windows ACCESS DENIED) ⇒ fail fast with typed BusAccessDeniedException.ForSectionCapacity surfaced via BusWriter.LastOpenError + TapLog; runbook: stop ALL iCemDataMonitor processes incl. producer, start producer iCem.exe FIRST, POC consumers after; module retry loop re-opens once holders exit
